fact: GETESA's technical director said on 19 May 2025 that coverage stood at about 70-75% in provincial and district capitals and that a national coverage project had begun to be implemented, with network sharing and GITGE fibre.
title: Director Técnico de GETESA: En las cabeceras provinciales y distritales podríamos decir que tenemos cobertura más o menos a un 70% o 75%
